content:
The City of Laredo Utilities Department will replace aging water valves near the 2600 block of Zacatecas Street on Friday night, November 6, as part of ongoing work to maintain and improve the city's water system, according to the City of Laredo.

The work begins at 8:00 p.m. and is expected to take 10 to 12 hours, with crews working overnight.

Residents and businesses in District 2 within the following boundaries, including surrounding areas, may experience low to no water pressure while the work is underway: east to west, from Zapata Highway to Ejido Avenue; north to south, from Chestnut Street to Lomas del Sur.

Residents and businesses in the affected areas are encouraged to plan ahead and prepare for possible water pressure disruptions.

Questions or concerns can be directed to 3-1-1.

Sources: City of Laredo.

title: Water Valve Work Tonight in District 2 May Leave Some Without Water Pressure
